mapper.select: select r.actor_member_id as actorId, l.member_id as creatorId, concat('', l.id) as itemRef, max(l.title) as itemTitle, min(r.created_at) as occurTime from template_adoption_receipt r join cms_template_library l on l.id = r.source_id where r.status = 'COMPLETED' and r.created_at >= #{from} and r.created_at < #{to} and l.member_id > 0 and l.member_id <> r.actor_member_id and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('ADOPT:T', l.id, ':', r.actor_member_id)) group by r.actor_member_id, l.member_id, l.id order by min(r.created_at), l.id, r.actor_member_id limit #{limit}

select i.buyer_id as actorId, v.seller_id as creatorId, v.version_id as itemRef, max(json_unquote(json_extract(v.content_json, '$.title'))) as itemTitle, min(i.installed_at) as occurTime from workshop_install i join workshop_order o on o.order_no = i.order_no join workshop_version v on v.version_id = o.version_id where i.draft_id is not null and i.installed_at is not null and i.installed_at >= #{from} and i.installed_at < #{to} and v.seller_id <> i.buyer_id and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('INSTALL:', v.version_id, ':', i.buyer_id)) group by i.buyer_id, v.seller_id, v.version_id order by min(i.installed_at), v.version_id, i.buyer_id limit #{limit}

select p.id as progressId, p.member_id as actorId, l.member_id as creatorId, concat('', l.id) as itemRef, l.title as itemTitle, p.checkin_time as occurTime from player_node_progress p join cms_topic_node n on n.id = p.node_id join cms_member_template t on t.id = n.template_id join cms_template_library l on l.id = (case when t.original_template_id > 0 then t.original_template_id else (select min(x.id) from cms_template_library x where x.member_template_id = t.id) end) where p.status = 1 and coalesce(p.del_flag, 0) = 0 and p.checkin_time >= #{from} and p.checkin_time < #{to} and l.member_id > 0 and l.member_id <> p.member_id and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('PLAY:', p.id)) order by p.checkin_time, p.id limit #{limit}

select p.id as progressId, p.member_id as actorId, v.seller_id as creatorId, v.version_id as itemRef, json_unquote(json_extract(v.content_json, '$.title')) as itemTitle, p.checkin_time as occurTime from player_node_progress p join cms_topic_node n on n.id = p.node_id left join workshop_install i on i.draft_id = n.template_id left join workshop_draft_lineage g on g.draft_id = n.template_id join workshop_order o on o.order_no = coalesce(i.order_no, g.order_no) join workshop_version v on v.version_id = o.version_id where p.status = 1 and coalesce(p.del_flag, 0) = 0 and p.checkin_time >= #{from} and p.checkin_time < #{to} and n.template_id > 0 and v.seller_id <> p.member_id and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('PLAY:', p.id)) order by p.checkin_time, p.id limit #{limit}

select o.order_no as orderNo, o.buyer_id as actorId, v.seller_id as creatorId, v.version_id as itemRef, json_unquote(json_extract(v.content_json, '$.title')) as itemTitle, o.paid_at as occurTime, coalesce(o.amount_fen, floor(o.amount_milliunits / 10)) as grossMinor, coalesce(o.currency, 'CNY') as currency from workshop_order o join workshop_version v on v.version_id = o.version_id where o.paid_at is not null and o.paid_at >= #{from} and o.paid_at < #{to} and v.seller_id <> o.buyer_id and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('SALE:', o.order_no)) order by o.paid_at, o.id limit #{limit}

select o.order_no as orderNo, o.buyer_id as actorId, o.refunded_at as occurTime from workshop_order o where o.state = 'REFUNDED' and o.refunded_at is not null and o.refunded_at >= #{from} and o.refunded_at < #{to} and exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger s where s.event_key = concat('SALE:', o.order_no)) and not exists (select 1 from creator_earning_ledger e where e.event_key = concat('SALE_REVERSAL:', o.order_no)) order by o.refunded_at, o.id limit #{limit}
select count(*) from creator_earning_ledger where event_key = #{eventKey}
select count(*) from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId} and occur_date = #{day} and event_type = 'PLAY' and points > 0

select creator_member_id as creatorId, item_kind as itemKind, item_ref as itemRef, item_title as itemTitle, gross_minor as grossMinor, creator_share_bps as shareBps, creator_minor as creatorMinor, currency, income_order_key as orderKey from creator_earning_ledger where event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into creator_earning_ledger (event_key, event_type, creator_member_id, actor_member_id, item_kind, item_ref, item_title, source_ref, points, capped, gross_minor, creator_share_bps, creator_minor, currency, money_state, income_order_key, occur_time, occur_date, create_time) values (#{eventKey}, #{eventType}, #{creatorId}, #{actorId}, #{itemKind}, #{itemRef}, #{itemTitle}, #{sourceRef}, #{points}, #{capped}, #{grossMinor}, #{shareBps}, #{creatorMinor}, #{currency}, #{moneyState}, #{orderKey}, #{occurTime}, #{occurDate}, current_timestamp(3))

insert ignore into creator_income_detail (creator_id, source_type, source_id, idempotency_key, amount, points, income_status, occur_time, create_time, update_time) select cp.id, concat('R12_', e.event_type), e.id, concat('CEL:', e.id), e.creator_minor / 100, e.points, case when e.event_type = 'SALE_REVERSAL' then 2 when e.money_state = 'NONE' then 1 else 0 end, e.occur_time, now(), now() from creator_earning_ledger e join creator_profile cp on cp.member_id = e.creator_member_id and cp.apply_status = 1 where (e.points > 0 or e.creator_minor <> 0) and not exists (select 1 from creator_income_detail d where d.idempotency_key = concat('CEL:', e.id)) order by e.id limit #{limit}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(points), 0) as points, coalesce(sum(case when event_type = 'PLAY' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as plays, coalesce(sum(case when event_type = 'PLAY' and capped = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cappedPlays, coalesce(sum(case when event_type in ('ADOPT', 'INSTALL') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as uses, coalesce(sum(case when event_type = 'SALE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sales, count(distinct concat(item_kind, ':', item_ref)) as items from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId}

select currency, money_state as moneyState, sum(creator_minor) as creatorMinor from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId} and event_type in ('SALE', 'SALE_REVERSAL') group by currency, money_state order by currency, money_state

select item_kind as itemKind, item_ref as itemRef, max(item_title) as title, sum(case when event_type = 'PLAY' then 1 else 0 end) as plays, sum(case when event_type in ('ADOPT', 'INSTALL') then 1 else 0 end) as uses, sum(case when event_type = 'SALE' then 1 else 0 end) as sales, sum(points) as points, max(occur_time) as lastAt from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId} group by item_kind, item_ref order by sum(points) desc, max(occur_time) desc, item_kind, item_ref limit #{limit}

select income_order_key as orderKey, max(item_ref) as itemRef, max(currency) as currency, sum(case when event_type = 'SALE' then creator_minor else 0 end) as creatorAmount, -sum(case when event_type = 'SALE_REVERSAL' then creator_minor else 0 end) as refundedAmount, count(*) as revision, min(case when event_type = 'SALE' then occur_time end) as paidAt from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId} and income_order_key is not null and income_order_key < #{before} group by income_order_key order by income_order_key desc limit #{limit}

select id, event_type as eventType, item_ref as itemRef, currency, creator_minor as creatorMinor, occur_time as occurTime from creator_earning_ledger where creator_member_id = #{creatorId} and income_order_key = #{orderKey} order by id
